description: Fetch web pages and convert them into clean LLM-ready text for RAG pipelines. Use when an agent needs readable page content from the web without HTML noise — a lightweight browser alternative for retrieval. Returns per-page cleaned text with metadata. Pricing: $0.003 per page crawled.

lang.description: Language code for search results (e.g. en, fr, de)
lang.title: Search language

maxResults.description: Maximum number of search results / pages to process
maxResults.title: Max results

outputFormat.description: Content format: markdown (best for LLM/RAG) or plain text
outputFormat.title: Output format

query.description: Google search query. Top results are fetched and extracted. Example: 'best crm software 2026'
query.title: Search query

urls.description: Direct page URLs to extract content from (instead of searching). Example: ["https://example.com/article"]
urls.title: URLs to extract

name: rag_web_browser
